title: Apply for a rally vehicle registration
summary: Apply for a conditional registration if you plan to operate a rally vehicle under the rally vehicle scheme.
intro: If you want to operate a rally vehicle, you'll need to apply for a conditional registration under the rally vehicle scheme (RVS).
who_can_apply: Be a financial member of an approved organisation (AMSAG or Motorsport Australia).
Hold a class C or higher driver licence.
Hold a competition licence (if an individual) or an entrants/competitors licence (if a corporation).
As the registered operator, the vehicle must have passed an inspection as an eligible rally vehicle within the last 42 days.
what_you_need: Rally Vehicle Declaration form (PDF), signed by an approved organisation representative.
Licensed certifier report (if required in the technical manual).
Proof of identity (e.g., NSW Driver Licence).
Proof of registration entitlement (e.g., original vehicle receipt).

how_to_steps.text: Download, complete, print and sign the Application for Conditional Registration form – PDF.
Download, complete and print the Rally Vehicle Declaration – PDF and have it signed by the responsible person of an approved organisation, either AMSAG or Motorsport Australia.
Take your completed forms and supporting documents to a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: Rally vehicles under the RVS may only operate on roads and road related areas:

Conditional registration is not transferable. The vehicle's new owner/operator has to apply for a new conditional registration. If a rally vehicle is sold or disposed of, you have to surrender the conditional registration.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a rally vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You must be a financial member of an approved organisation, such as the Australian Motor Sport Action Group (AMSAG) or Motorsport Australia. You must also hold a class C or higher driver licence and have the appropriate competition or entrants/competitors licence.

faqs.q: What must the rally vehicle meet before I apply?
faqs.a: The vehicle must have passed an inspection as an eligible rally vehicle within the last 42 days.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my completed application?
faqs.a: Take your completed forms and supporting documents to a Service NSW Centre.
